_what_this_is: A COUNT, and deliberately nothing else. Operator decision 2026-09-21 under
HOS-54: every test written before that date is disabled, none is deleted,
and the bodies are not in this repository.
AN EARLIER VERSION OF THIS FILE CARRIED THE ADDRESS AND ALL 1471 FILENAMES,
and the operator removed both on sight, for a reason worth writing down so
that nobody restores them as a convenience: 'nothing in the system should know
where the old tests are, or something could go and run them by itself, and we
do not want that' (translated). A path in a manifest is not documentation, it is an
instruction something will eventually follow. A number is not.
So: nothing in this repository resolves, locates, enumerates or runs a
parked test. One is run by the operator naming it, when he asks for it, and
by nothing else.
WHY THE BODIES LEFT, stated without the inventory that made the case. A
large test corpus accumulates, file name by file name and docstring by
docstring, a description of the tree it runs against and of what the
machine it runs on is wired to. No single line of it is a credential and no
gate would have refused any of it, which is exactly why nothing caught it.
It is disclosure by accumulation, and this repository is public.
The measurement that established it was taken once, reported to the
operator, and is deliberately NOT written here. A count of how many parked
files named which private directory is the same disclosure in shorter form,
and this is the one file in the repository whose entire purpose is to carry
a number and no description of what was parked.
THE RESIDUAL, stated rather than left to be discovered: all 1471 filenames
are still in this repository's git history, because they were tracked here
until 2026-09-21. CLAUDE.md already requires that history to be rewritten
before the engine is ever made public, and this file does not change that
requirement or discharge it.
direction: may only fall; a rise is refused and is the operator's to authorise
